proposition: Every modeled path from prior deployment state to production for revision R in environment E contains required gates, provided the deployment-state acquisition has first been authenticated against an external trust root and bound to the same subject.
notes: Material fields cannot grant their own trust. The compiler defaults acquisition_trusted to false and therefore fails closed until an authenticated caller injects that result.
Explicit schema without trusted acquisition remains advisory/candidate only.
This profile cannot be strict-eligible without candidate-bound executed qualification evidence.
